entities.name: Ibn Battuta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Moroccan scholar and explorer (1304–1368/69) whose travels across the Islamic world and beyond covered approximately 73,000 miles over 29 years — one of the greatest journeys of the pre-modern era. His Rihla (Travels) provides unparalleled firsthand accounts of medieval societies from West Africa to China.
